checks: A guest impact transfers real impulse to the shared NPC, returns a guest-tagged offense contact, preserves the owner pose, and resolves a received pose only once.
Shared police receive the colliding guest ID, allowing the normal offense path to target the guest instead of the host.
Plausible fast motion between received poses uses a swept contact and cannot skip through an NPC between snapshots.
Teleports do not sweep across the map; away, stale and nonfinite poses cannot hit traffic, and reset clears contact history.
scope: Real planar collision solver with authoritative NPC body fixtures; no native engine update and no live network claim.
